Perform these 5 renames consecutively, possibly batched if you know how. Use rename-plan.md, update every call site, preserve behavior, and run go test ./... before finishing. Do not use semantic editing MCP tools; use standard file editing. When done, output DONE.

tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile
replacements = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
}
for path in sorted(Path('pipeline').glob('*.go')):
    if path.name.endswith('_test.go'):
        continue
    original = path.read_text()
    updated = original
    for old, new in replacements.items():
        updated = updated.replace(old, new)
    if updated == original:
        continue
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix=f'.{path.name}.')
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as stream:
            stream.write(updated)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)
PY
rg -n \"LoadInput|CheckInput|NormalizeValue|MapFields|RouteValue|ReadRequest|ValidateRequest|CanonicalizeValue|ProjectFields|DispatchValue\" pipeline --glob '"'!**/*_test.go'"'
git diff -- pipeline"
